notes: HR reference data for Congolese companies (docs/modules/hr.md HR-03, HR-12, HR-13): identifier types and statutory leave types. Each row has a status (ResearchStatus): 'researched' values come from public research (docs/country-packs-research-2026-10.md) with their confidence, research date and sources; they are used, and leave records that use them say so until the owner confirms them through a pack release (ADM-04). Owner decision 2026-10-22: low-confidence research is entered and used too, shown as 'Researched, low confidence: not confirmed by an accountant'. pay_share: a paid type paid at a share of pay, an exact fraction (maternity: 2/3, Code du travail art. 130); payroll deducts the rest of the daily rate. seniority: more yearly days per completed years of service (annual: one working day per five years, art. 141). A null pattern enforces no format; a null days value makes the leave type 'Days needed' (requests and accrual refused) until a tenant confirms it. events: per-event days within the type's yearly days (circumstantial leave: at most 10 working days a year, not deducted from annual leave, Code du travail art. 146). Labels live in lang/{locale}/hr.php (pack.*).
todo: Confirm every researched value, then publish it as confirmed through a pack release (ADM-04): maternity 14 weeks (98 calendar days) at 2/3 of pay, annual leave 18 working days a year after 12 months with one more day per 5 years of service, and circumstantial leave (10 working days a year; own marriage 2, birth of a child 2).

annual (low confidence, owner decision 2026-10-22): 18 working days a year (1.5 a month) is used. The Code du travail text found (art. 141, Wikisource; a lawyer's note citing a 2015 ruling) gives adults at least 1 working day per month (12 a year) and workers under 18 at least 1.5 a month, plus 1 working day per 5 years of seniority. 18 days is above the adult minimum; confirm which the company owes.

sick: the Code du travail (art. 105) keeps 2/3 of cash pay for the whole suspension for ordinary illness, with no number of days; art. 106: 2/3 for the first six months for an occupational accident or disease; art. 60: the employer may end the contract after six months' uninterrupted incapacity. No day count is stated, so the type stays 'Days needed': each company sets its days (and pay).
maternity: a 2023 private member's bill proposes full pay; not adopted as far as found.
circumstantial: the other events (death of a spouse, child or parent, and so on) and their days, with legal references.
national_id and cnss_number: no reliable format found; not enforced.
